rows.grounds: locative of the bodily center maṇipūra
numeral specifying the count or measure of retention

items.question: In which bodily center and for what count must retention be performed?
premises: The instruction directly addresses the great goddess.
Retention is prescribed in the manipura center.
The specified count for retention is sixty-four.
items.inference: Therefore the practitioner should retain in manipura for sixty-four measures.
uncertainties: The unit counted by sixty-four is not explicitly stated in this verse.
items.plain_english: O great goddess, one should retain in maṇipūra for sixty-four.
